mapper.select: SELECT id, title, platform, content, quote, status, published_at, views, likes FROM content_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

INSERT INTO content_record(user_id, title, platform, content, quote, status, published_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{record.title}, #{record.platform}, #{record.content}, #{record.quote}, COALESCE(#{record.status}, 'DRAFT'), CASE WHEN #{record.status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE content_record SET title = #{title}, platform = #{platform}, content = #{content}, quote = #{quote}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE content_record SET status = #{status}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE published_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM content_record WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM created_at)::int AS "day", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM content_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
